headline: Solana Funding Flips From Negative 0.001 Percent To A Calm 0.002 Percent
narrative: Solana perpetual funding flipped from a negative 0.001 percent print, where shorts were crowded and paying longs, to a calm 0.002 percent. A negative rate on that pipe means short positions pay long positions for the right to stay open. The calm print means longs pay a small rate instead, with the recent average at 0.004 percent and the recent peak at 0.01 percent.
author: jordan
